headline: faster machine is all you need vaults to third on ARC-3

sections.text: faster machine is all you need added 30.18 points to reach 58.59, leaping from 1,274th to third on the public ARC-AGI-3 board.

The jump puts the entry into the gold places and just behind the top two. The roster lists xiaoz259, whose Kaggle profile identifies a decorated competitions competitor; the brief establishes no ARC method behind this result.
